contract: Each caller owns only its wait. Cancelling one waiter must not cancel a shared operation while any other waiter remains active. Once the last waiter cancels, transport cancellation is required. Completed responses settle active waiters only.

expectedFindings.symptom: Two callers join one lookup; caller a cancels and is removed.
expectedFindings.source: Two callers join one lookup; caller a cancels and is removed. Unconditional abort cancels the transport even though b remains. Later completion rejects b as cancelled instead of delivering its result. Reference-counted cancellation preserves b and still aborts when the last waiter leaves.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Tie shared transport cancellation to the last active waiter, while settling each caller independently and removing completed flights.
